intents.label: audio_playback
intents.definition: Music pausing unexpectedly, buffering, stuttering, sound cut-offs, volume issues, or songs stopping when switching apps or receiving notifications.
intents.example: @SpotifyCares why does spotify pause my music everytime i try to go to another app?

intents.label: app_crash
intents.definition: App crashing on launch, freezing, black screen, iOS or Android bugs, app not optimized for new device (e.g. iPhone X), or requests for compatibility updates.
intents.example: @SpotifyCares update the iPhone X app please

intents.label: account_login
intents.definition: Login errors, inability to sign in, Facebook connect issues, credentials not working, account access lost after Facebook account deletion, or forgotten password.
intents.example: @SpotifyCares I deleted my facebook account which was linked to my Spotify account. I can't log anymore into Spotify

intents.label: account_security
intents.definition: Compromised accounts, unauthorized email or password changes, account takeover, unusual activity, hacking, or situations requiring immediate account freeze. HIGH RISK — always escalate.
intents.example: @SpotifyCares my account suddenly logged me out on all devices and says my email doesn't exist anymore

intents.label: billing_dispute
intents.definition: Being charged without having Premium, double charges, unauthorized transactions, account billed after cancellation, payment showing as processed but account still showing as free. HIGH RISK — always escalate.
intents.example: @SpotifyCares you guys charged my account even though I don't have premium!

intents.label: subscription_refund
intents.definition: Explicit requests for refunds, charges after cancellation refund requests, disputed payment refund claims. HIGH RISK — always escalate.
intents.example: @SpotifyCares I want a refund I was charged after I cancelled

intents.label: subscription_upgrade
intents.definition: Student discount verification, Premium Duo or Family plan setup, Hulu bundle activation, eligibility questions about promotional offers, upgrading from free to paid.
intents.example: @SpotifyCares I already have an existing Student Premium Account, But i can't find the link to activate my Hulu account with it.

intents.label: playlist_content_missing
intents.definition: Missing playlists, albums not showing up, specific artists or songs unavailable on Spotify, content licensing questions, artist content not yet on platform.
intents.example: @115888 add the Perfect Velvet album right now i've been waiting all damn day

intents.label: download_offline
intents.definition: Offline songs un-downloading, downloaded songs disappearing, storage limits for offline listening, issues with offline mode toggle, songs not syncing for offline use.

intents.label: other_unclear
intents.definition: Message does not fit any defined intent, or intent is unclear from the available text. Includes emoji-only tweets, generic thank-you replies, URL-only messages, vague complaints without actionable detail.
